data.narrative:
Airrow is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Menachem Fehler and David Kaye. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers across the Defense & Security sector—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two primary valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method, using Airrow's $350K total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implied a valuation of $875K. The Peer-Median method examined 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yielding a median valuation of $700M across a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis across two methods supports a range of $744K (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $350M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in stage-appropriate valuation: the stage-progression method reflects early-stage financing fundamentals, while peer multiples are dominated by outlier valuations at later stages. Resolution of this range depends critically on Airrow's product maturation, customer traction, and positioning relative to the high-end defense tech cohort represented by UFORCE and Stark Defence.
